newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine March deficit to be just under $550 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentine March deficit to be just under $550 mln.

text.p: Argentina's central government deficit will be a "little under" 550 million pesos in March compared with 650 million pesos a year earlier, Treasury Secretary Pablo Guidotti said Wednesday.
With this figure "we will meet the targets for March agreed (with the International Monetary Fund)," Guidotti told reporters.

Guidotti added that with an IMF mission now in Argentina monitoring the central government accounts, the authorities have started "to delineate a program so that when the next mission arrives, in May, the formal negotiations will start to set up an extended fund facility (for 1998 to 2000).
"In that program there will be ficsal targets for the next three years and there will be a focus on improving the foreign debt to gross domestic product ratio," Guidotti said.
Argentina's debt to GDP ratio is now around 31 percent.
